name: Afterflow
description: a predictive input cheat that fixes your early clicks and makes them accurate.

terminal-enabled.name: enable terminal
terminal-enabled.description: allow the terminal key to open the afterflow log window

wave-margin.name: wave safety margin
wave-margin.description: adds 1 extra tick of delay in wave when there is room. safer but can feel late. off = earliest safe click

loose-ground-saves.name: loose ground saves
loose-ground-saves.description: if no delay makes the cube land safely, still accept a delay that gets it past the obstacle that would have killed the raw click. more saves, slightly less strict

modes-title.name: gamemodes
modes-title.description: turn afterflow on or off per gamemode. applies when you resume or enter a level

mode-cube.name: cube
mode-cube.description: fix early cube clicks and releases

mode-ship.name: ship
mode-ship.description: fix ship / jetpack inputs (delays are kept small so the ship still feels responsive)

mode-robot.name: robot
mode-robot.description: fix robot jumps and hold length

feedback-title.name: feedback
feedback-title.description: the small text at the top of the level

show-feedback.name: show fixed text
show-feedback.description: shows a green text at the top of the level when afterflow successfully fixes a click

show-cant-save.name: show can't save text
show-cant-save.description: shows a red text when afterflow could not save a click. turn off to only see the green fixed text

feedback-units.name: fixed text units
feedback-units.description: how the fixed text shows the delay. ticks = 240 per second, frames = real frames at your current fps

perf-title.name: performance / high fps
perf-title.description: how long the prediction search may run when you click. applies when you resume or enter a level

auto-budget.name: auto search time
auto-budget.description: scales the search time to your real frame time so very high fps (500, 1000+, uncapped) does not stall frames. off = always use the max search time

min-search-ms.name: min search time (ms)
min-search-ms.description: the search never gets less time than this, even at extreme fps. too low and saves start failing

max-search-ms.name: max search time (ms)
max-search-ms.description: upper limit for the search time per click

android-title.name: android
android-title.description: android has no function keys or terminal, so the stage is picked here instead. the keybinds and terminal settings below only do something on pc

android-stage.name: stage (android)
android-stage.description: prediction stage on android. 1 = 2 ticks ... 7 = 40 ticks, 8 = off. applies when you resume or enter a level. ignored on pc (use the cycle key there)

keybinds-title.name: keybinds
keybinds-title.description: change geodes keybinding anytime for afterflow

keybind-terminal.name: terminal
keybind-terminal.description: open or close the afterflow terminal
